summary: Comprehensive testing of AI Listing Assistant UPDATE - Saved Prompts CRUD, Large Textarea, Drag-and-Drop, Vendoo-focused UI. Backend: 32/32 tests passed (100%) - all existing conversation/image/message tests + 11 new prompts CRUD tests. Frontend: All UI elements verified - large textarea (rows=4), drag-drop zone, saved prompts manager, no marketplace-specific buttons (eBay/Poshmark/Mercari/Depop/FB removed), Vendoo-focused welcome text.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend prompts CRUD properly validates required fields (label and text)
Prompts are correctly scoped to authenticated user (user A cannot see/edit/delete user B's prompts)
Frontend correctly removed marketplace-specific quick action buttons (eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, FB Marketplace)
Large textarea input (rows=4) implemented with proper placeholder text
Drag-and-drop zone shows overlay with 'Drop images here' text when dragging files
Saved prompts appear as clickable pills on welcome screen
Clicking a saved prompt correctly fills the input textarea
Edit/delete icons appear on hover for saved prompts
Send button shows 'Send' text next to arrow icon
Welcome screen mentions 'Vendoo listing' instead of marketplace-specific text

success_rate.backend: 100% (32/32 passed, 5 skipped due to admin token unavailability)
